verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a framework, so its documented public surface is its configuration and plugin API rather than an HTTP service. The evidence only glances at that surface: a link to a `/docs/api/docusaurus-config` reference and a mention of the pluggable architecture. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt or markdown docs endpoint. Missing for 10: substantive documentation of the programmatic API (config/plugin lifecycle reference contents), any machine-readable API spec, and hands-on evidence of driving the product programmatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
